hooks.text: 西部奇幻炼狱中对抗收割灵魂的黑帮
hooks.excerpt: You are a gunslinger in limbo, involved in a gritty war against "The Cartel", a ruthless organization harvesting souls to break free of the shackles of the afterlife.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每局锻造武器并在Haven解锁永久升级
hooks.excerpt: Forge your own destiny with every run by crafting powerful weapons and unlocking permanent upgrades in Haven.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 故事会根据肉鸽玩法中的行动变化
hooks.excerpt: The story adapts to what you do in the roguelike gameplay
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器音效缺乏力度与变化。

excerpts.excerpt: weapon audio lacks punch and variety
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 配乐是游戏最突出的元素之一

excerpts.excerpt: The soundtrack is one of the game’s strongest elements.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 崩溃会让肉鸽整局进度丢失。

excerpts.excerpt: you'll get a fatal error an lose all progress for the run.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 武器只能带一把有点搞
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: Meta progression seems very awkward and ineffective
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 存在单一可全程碾压的超强技能组合

excerpts.excerpt: find that 1 overwhelmingly OP skill combo that flat carries you through everything.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 远程击杀后的金币需要走过去拾取且会消失。

excerpts.excerpt: 击杀怪物后金币居然要走过去才能拿到否则就会消失
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 随机提供大量不适配构筑的无用天赋。

excerpts.excerpt: a bunch of trash perks that don't fit into the build
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 敌人可能穿模后无法攻击。

excerpts.excerpt: enemies falling through textures, being unreachable
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 使用冲刺可能导致致命崩溃。

excerpts.excerpt: fatal crash because I dared to use dash
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 崩溃会随游玩时间增长几乎必然发生。

excerpts.excerpt: crashing is pretty much guaranteed the longer you play
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。

risks: 武器音效缺乏力度与变化。
技术/性能：崩溃会让肉鸽整局进度丢失。
存在单一可全程碾压的超强技能组合
远程击杀后的金币需要走过去拾取且会消失。
技术/性能：敌人可能穿模后无法攻击。
技术/性能：使用冲刺可能导致致命崩溃。
